assignments.name: Message

parameters.query:
SELECT        d.id AS districtID, d.name AS DistrictName, u.adminaccount, u.active, d.techcontact, d.techphone, d.techemail, d.sistype, u.userid, u.firstname, u.lastname, d.lastDataSync LastSync, DATEDIFF(day, d.lastDataSync, GETDATE()) as Duration
FROM            evitesting.dbo.ecDistricts AS d LEFT OUTER JOIN
                         evitesting.dbo.ecUsers AS u ON d.id = u.districtid
WHERE        (u.userid = '{{ $json.message.content.Login.Login }}')
